name: fmp_forex_historical
description:
Daily end-of-day rate history (open, high, low, close) for one currency pair from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/historical-price-eod/full as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (pair, e.g. EURUSD), from_date (YYYY-MM-DD), to_date (YYYY-MM-DD).
For the latest quote use fmp_forex_quote; for pairs fmp_forex_list.
Example: {"symbol": "EURUSD", "from_date": "2025-01-01", "to_date": "2025-03-31"}
